about: SQLite migrations, and the first statement of each that controls the transaction, which a migration can't hold of its own: null where it has none. engine/migrate/src/sql.rs (atomicity_problem) and src/migration-text.ts (transactionControl) are both held to it. A trigger ends at the ; after an end that itself follows a ;, as sqlite3_complete reads one.
